title: Verbal Periphrases: Start, Stop, and Repeat

sections.content:
Verbal periphrases combine a conjugated auxiliary verb + preposition (optional) + non-finite verb (infinitive or gerund) to express precise phases of an action:

1. Inception: empezar a + inf. / comenzar a + inf. (to begin doing)
2. Cessation: dejar de + inf. (to stop doing / quit)
3. Repetition: volver a + inf. (to do again)

sections.title: Action Phase Periphrases
rows: Empecé a estudiar español hace un año. (I started studying...)
Carlos dejó de fumar. (Carlos stopped smoking.)
Volví a ver esa película. (I watched that movie again.)

items.spanish: De repente empezó a llover intensamente.
items.english: Suddenly it started to rain heavily.

items.spanish: Dejó de trabajar a las seis de la tarde.
items.english: She stopped working at six in the evening.
